description: He wears an opaque deep purple floor-length noble coat with long wide sleeves and richly woven gold floral-geometric borders along the front, cuffs and hem. A cream full-length undertunic shows gold-and-purple woven borders at its neck, sleeves, vertical front and lower hem. A burgundy shoulder drape crosses the upper torso and hangs at one side, fastened by a round jeweled gold-toned brooch. An ornate broad gold-toned belt closes at a decorated clasp. Dark leather shoes have gold-toned embroidered floral motifs. No headgear or weapon is visible.
